name: What is the cost of zoning coordination for an ADU?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of ADU zoning coordination in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank, and what drives the fee up?
mainEntity.text: What is the cost of ADU zoning coordination in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank, and what drives the fee up?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of zoning coordination varies because the work can be very light or very involved. A simple feasibility check may only require a parcel review and code summary, while a complicated lot may need multiple rounds of site analysis, design adjustments, and coordination with city-specific requirements. Costs usually rise when the project includes irregular lot dimensions, historic restrictions, tight setbacks, multiple building options, or a need to coordinate across design, surveying, and permitting. In practical terms, owners are not just paying for rule interpretation; they are paying to avoid design mistakes that can cost far more later. The most cost-efficient approach is to complete the zoning review before final drawings are produced. That way, the budget is spent on a plan that is likely to pass rather than on revisions after submittal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Zoning coordination cost depends on parcel complexity, city-specific review needs, and whether the work is limited to feasibility or includes redesign support. Complicated lots, historic review, and multiple concept revisions usually increase the cost.
